question: The Cisco Nexus switch Generic Online Diagnostics policy for a PortLoopback test requires 10 consecutive failures to error disable the port. The customer wants to change it to 5 consecutive failures. Which configuration applies the changes for module 1 only?
options: Nexus(config)# event manager applet custom-PortLoopback override __PortLoopback Nexus(config-applet)# event gold mod all test PortLoopback testing-type bootup consecutive-failure 5 Nexus(config-applet)# action 1 publish-event

Nexus(config)# event manager applet custom-PortLoopback override __PortLoopback Nexus(config-applet)# event gold mod 1 test PortLoopback testing-type monitoring consecutive-failure 5 Nexus(config-applet)# action 1 publish-default

Nexus(config)# event manager applet custom-PortLoopback override __PortLoopback Nexus(config-applet)# event gold mod all test PortLoopback testing-type monitoring consecutive-failure 5 Nexus(config-applet)# action 1 policy-default

Nexus(config)# event manager applet custom-PortLoopback override __PortLoopback Nexus(config-applet)# event gold mod 1 test PortLoopback testing-type bootup consecutive-failure 5 Nexus(config-applet)# action 1 policy-event
theory: Overriding a GOLD diagnostic system policy (names beginning with '__') requires specifying the correct testing-type — 'monitoring' here, since you're adjusting the ongoing runtime failure threshold rather than a one-time bootup test — along with the new consecutive-failure count, and closing with 'action 1 policy-default' so the rest of the original system policy's default actions still execute after your override. The other option combinations use invalid or mismatched testing-type/action keywords for a GOLD policy override. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools) / (Cisco documentation / web research)
